pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark patches exhibit highly irregular, stellate geometry with sharp, jagged pixel-level gradients at the margins. The spatial area is non-uniform, with larger contiguous regions on the neck and more fractured, smaller sub-regions on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-pigmented corridors form a continuous topological graph with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these pathways is highly variable, fluctuating based on the serrated intrusion of the neighboring patch edges.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck shows a continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile with a high frequency of fine hair-tuft peaks against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized textural disruption and raised protrusion is visible on the dorsal ridge at the shoulder junction. Multiple small, dark, hyper-pigmented spots are scattered across the mid-flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, raised, dark nodules consistent with parasitic lesions or cutaneous bumps are visible across the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two symbiotic avian organisms (Buphagus sp.)—one perched on the mid-neck and another on the dorsal ridge.
